mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.parent_id, g.name, g.display_order, g.active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE u.grade_id = g.id AND u.active = TRUE) AS user_count FROM emp_grades g ORDER BY g.display_order, g.id
SELECT g.id, g.parent_id, g.name, g.display_order, g.active, 0 AS user_count FROM emp_grades g WHERE g.active = TRUE ORDER BY g.display_order, g.id
SELECT g.name FROM users u JOIN emp_grades g ON g.id = u.grade_id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
